name: optimize_inefficient_stream_loop
description: Optimizes an O(n^2) duplicate-finder to run in roughly linear time
prompts: DuplicateFinder.findDuplicates(List<Integer> nums) (src/main/java/com/optarena/perf/DuplicateFinder.java) correctly returns every value that appears more than once in `nums`, but it uses a nested loop plus a `.contains()` check on the growing result list, making it O(n^2) - far too slow for large inputs (tens of thousands of elements). Rewrite it to run in roughly linear time using HashSet/HashMap-based counting instead of nested loops or repeated `.contains()` scans, while keeping the exact same public method signature `List<Integer> findDuplicates(List<Integer> nums)` and the same result semantics: every value occurring 2 or more times must appear exactly once in the returned list (the order of the returned list does not matter).
